title: Multistain Pretraining for Slide Representation Learning in Pathology
population_or_data: Breast cancer and kidney transplant WSIs.
main_findings: Multiple stains serve as pretraining views for transferable slide embeddings.
limitations: Local copy is arXiv v1; breast/kidney results are not cardiac clinical validation.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No established gain from our stain presence mask or event classifier.
relevance_to_project: Tests a different role for stains than explicit task-time branch fusion.
